ByteSize.description: A size such as "256MiB", "512m" or "1GiB", or bytes.

Duration.description: A duration such as "500ms", "30s", "10m", "2h" or "1d", or whole seconds.

accounts.description:
Account per server on the default endpoint, for servers whose
secrets use `{account}`: `accounts = { github = "work" }`.
Profiles (M2-07) set their own. Default: `default`.

allow_agent_add_servers.description: Whether the agent may add new backend servers itself. Default: `false`.

allowed_origins.description:
Extra browser origins allowed to call the daemon, e.g.
`"http://localhost:5173"`. The daemon's own origin is always allowed.

approval_timeout.description:
How long a call to an `approve`-listed tool waits for `mcpgw approve`
when the client can't be asked. Default: `"2m"`.

client_metadata_url.description:
HTTPS URL of a client ID metadata document describing mcpgw, used as
the OAuth client id for remote MCP servers that accept them
(otherwise mcpgw registers itself dynamically).

idle_timeout.description:
Stop a server after this long without calls (per-server
`idle_timeout` overrides it). Default: `"10m"`.

listen.description:
Address of the HTTP front door; must be a loopback address.
Default: `127.0.0.1:7777`.

max_running.description:
Most servers running at once; starting one more stops the least
recently used idle server. Default: 16.

mode.description:
How tools are presented to clients: `meta` (default: only
`search_tools`, `describe_tool`, `call_tool`), `direct` (every tool)
or `hybrid` (meta-tools plus `pinned_tools`).

oauth_refresh_interval.description:
How often the daemon checks for OAuth tokens to refresh.
Default: `"60s"`.

pinned_tools.description: Public tool names always listed in `hybrid` mode.

policy.description:
Tool policy for the default endpoint (profiles have their own):
`policy = { deny = ["*__delete_*"], approve = ["gh__merge_*"] }`.

registry_url.description:
MCP Registry used by `mcpgw add <name>` and `mcpgw registry search`.
Default: `https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io`.

store_path.description: Path to the SQLite store. Default: `<data dir>/mcpgw/mcpgw.db`.

token_path.description:
Path of the static loopback auth token file.
Default: `<data dir>/mcpgw/token`.

vault_path.description: Path of the secret vault. Default: `vault.json` next to the store.

memory.description: Memory cap; exceeding it kills the server (no swap).

Mode.description: How a profile presents tools to the client.

oneOf.description: Meta-tools plus the profile's pinned tools.

OAuthProvider.description: One OAuth app (`[[oauth]]` in the config file).

client_secret.description: Vault secret holding the client secret, for confidential apps.

name.description: Name used in `mcpgw auth connect <name>` and secret names.

preset.description: Built-in endpoints to start from: `github`, `google` or `atlassian`.

scopes.description: Scopes to request (the preset's when empty).

Policy.description:
Tool policy: glob lists matched against public tool names
(`<server>__<tool>`). `*` matches any run of characters, `?` one.

Precedence: `deny` beats `approve`, which beats `allow`. When `allow` is
empty every tool not denied is allowed.

allow.description: Tools that may be called. Empty means all.

approve.description: Tools that need a human approval per call.

Profile.description: A named profile (`[[profile]]` in the config file).

accounts.description: Account bindings: server name → account label (`github` → `work`).

pinned_tools.description: Public tool names always listed directly in `hybrid` mode.

servers.description: Servers in this profile. Empty means every enabled server.

Sandbox.description: How tightly a container server is confined.

oneOf.description: No restrictions beyond the server's own [`Limits`].

All capabilities dropped, no privilege escalation, 1 GiB memory and
512 processes unless set.

`standard`, plus a read-only root filesystem with a 64 MiB tmpfs at
`/tmp`, running as uid/gid 65534 (nobody), and defaults of 512 MiB,
1 CPU and 128 processes.

ServerSpec.description: One backend tool server (`[[server]]` in the config file).

oneOf.description: Spawn a local child process speaking MCP over stdio.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the child.

oneOf.description: Connect to a remote Streamable HTTP endpoint.

Run an OCI image with Docker or Podman, speaking MCP over the
container's stdin/stdout (`run -i`, attached). The container is
removed when the server stops.

digest.description:
Pinned content digest (`sha256:…`): the container always runs
exactly this image, pulled by digest. `mcpgw add` fills it in.

egress.description:
Network allowlist, `["api.github.com:443"]`: the container can
reach these host:port pairs and nothing else. `[]` means no
network at all. Unset: unrestricted.

env.description:
Environment variables set inside the container (values are passed
through the runtime's environment, never on its command line).

run_args.description:
Extra `run` flags, e.g. `["-p", "127.0.0.1:8085:8085"]`. They
come after the sandbox's flags, so they can add to them
(`--cap-add=…`).

runtime.description: `docker` or `podman`. Default: whichever is installed, Docker first.

alias.description:
Shorter prefix for its tools' public names (`<alias>__<tool>`).
Default: the name.

enabled.description: Whether the gateway may start this server. Default: `true`.

files.description:
Secrets written to files (container servers): container path →
vault secret, e.g. `{ "/run/secrets/sa.json" = "gcp_sa" }`. Each is
a read-only file in tmpfs, gone when the server stops.

idle_timeout.description: Stop the server after this long without calls. Default: gateway-wide.

limits.description:
Resource limits: `{ memory = "256MiB", cpus = 0.5, pids = 64 }`.
Container servers take all three (unset ones come from the sandbox
profile); stdio servers take `memory`, a cap on the process tree.

registry.description:
Where it was installed from, when `mcpgw add` took it from the MCP
Registry.

secrets.description:
Secrets injected at spawn: environment variable → vault secret name,
e.g. `{ GITHUB_TOKEN = "github_token" }`. Args and env values may
also contain `${secret:<name>}`. Injected values are redacted from
everything the server sends back.

startup_timeout.description: Deadline for start-up and the MCP handshake. Default: gateway-wide.

stateful.description:
The server keeps user state (browser, database session): it is never
stopped for idleness or evicted.
